Data Intern, Howrah Analytics, Remote | June 2025 - July 2025 (6 weeks)

PROJECTS
- Book Exchange Portal: Django web app where students list and swap used books, with login and search.
- Expense Tracker API: Small Flask API storing expenses in SQLite.
- Telegram bot that sends the college timetable each morning, written in Python.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS

SKILLS
Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Flask, MySQL, SQLite, SQL, OOP, Git, pandas, HTML, CSS

- Member, college debating society.
